notes: Lets one phone keep multiple computers paired and independently connected, with an online indicator, count, device list, and active-computer switcher.
Keeps Clipboard items, Agent reminders, files, drafts, transfer state, and notification diagnostics isolated by source computer.
Adds new computers from a QR code without replacing existing pairings or reloading the running PWA.
Prefers same-network WebRTC and falls back to an end-to-end encrypted relay that stores no Clipboard or file content.
Lets phone users switch the in-app DingDong icon between soft-blue and white backgrounds.
Keeps notification deep links pairing-safe and backs off reconnect attempts after repeated network failures.
Keeps Intel macOS and Windows packages marked as beta.
